The core rulebook puts them at 10, 13 and 16, and each higher tier reveals more about the enemy. A forum post about the errata says they were lowered to 7, 10 and 13. I couldn't confirm that from an official page, so check which version your table uses. I also can't give you what each tier reveals with confidence. The one detail I found is that the 10+ tier shows the enemy's species and its maximum HP and MP.
